sn36.5:1.1: imā bhikkhave vedanā || katamā tisso || || Sukhā vedanā dukkhā vedanā adukkhamasukā vedanā || || Sukhā bhikkhave vedanā dukkhato daṭṭhabbā || dukkhā vedanā sallato daṭṭhabbā || adukkhamasukhā vedanā aniccato daṭṭhabbā || || Yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno sukhā vedanā dukkhato diṭṭhā honti || dukkhā vedanā sallato diṭṭhā hoti || adukkhamasukhā vedanā aniccato diṭṭha hoti || ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu sammaddaso acchejji taṇham vivattayi saṃyojanaṃ sammamānābhisamayā antam akāsi dukkhassā ti || ||
sn36.5:2.1: Yo sukhaṃ dukkhato adda || dukkham adakkhi sallato || adukkhamasukhaṃ santaṃ || adakkhi nam aniccato || ||
sn36.5:3.1: Sa ve sammaddaso bhikkhu || parijānāti vedanā || So vedanā pariññāya || diṭṭhadhamme anāsavo || Kāyassa bhedā dhammaṭṭho || saṅkhaṃ nupeti vedagūti || || Assutavā
